body [romansod 2026-08-16 16:32]
  ## Problem
  `r-pr-comments` gives a reliable view of PR discussion but rejects an issue
  number. We want the same for issues without duplicating the renderer.

  ## Options
  1. A second script.
  2. Rename to `r-gh-comments`.
  3. One implementation, both entry points.

comment [alice 2026-08-16 18:00]
  Option 3, and let the API resolve the type — `issueOrPullRequest`
  means the number is never ambiguous.
